parsed.notes: Only compliance is stated; no actual ratio values are disclosed. The minimum liquidity limit is in $ millions. On October 16, 2026, after the quarter ended, an amendment lowered the liquidity covenant from $80 million to $60 million and added $70 million of revolving commitments. Secured net leverage ratio references only set the margin and commitment fee, and the first lien, secured and total net leverage tests apply to incremental loan incurrence, so both are excluded.
